members.name: description
members.doc: Supporting text under the title, which also describes the Dialog.

members.name: actions
members.doc: The buttons under the content.

members.name: open
members.doc: Whether the Dialog is open, when the caller controls it.

members.name: defaultOpen
members.doc: Whether the Dialog starts open, when it controls itself.

members.name: dismissable
members.doc: Whether Escape, an outside press, the trigger, and the built-in close button close the Dialog. When false, the Dialog renders no close button of its own, and only a button in the close slot closes it.

members.name: trigger
members.doc: The element that opens the Dialog. Without one, only open or defaultOpen opens it.

members.name: backdropClassName
members.doc: A class added to the backdrop beside Mux UI's own.

members.doc: A class added to the actions beside Mux UI's own.

members.name: closeClassName
members.doc: A class added to the built-in close button beside Mux UI's own.

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Reports the Dialog opening or closing. A Dialog that is not dismissable reports no close from Escape, an outside press, or the trigger.
